timing: Explicit post-hoc diagnostic after coarse matched summaries were inspected; not an untouched validation.
reason: Peak of equal-stage group means and peak of an individual stage are distinct and need not be nested. Test dependence of descriptive excess on that reference resolution.
universe: Same frozen primary/source unique tested symbols, same control-abundance and dominance definitions, same fixed36 priorities.
additional_constraint: Third scheme also requires exact native single-stage peak label in addition to same native peak-of-group-means label; never reclassify groups from single-stage peak.
same_targets: Use targets matchable under all three schemes within each cohort/reference/caliper, then compare all schemes on precisely that common set. Do not compare to the earlier coarse-only target means as if denominators were unchanged.
ranking: Same normalized abundance + group-dominance distance and lexicographic ties; fine-stage descriptor is an additional exact constraint.
endpoint: Mean and median per-priority excess, threshold-proportion difference and delete-one-priority influence ranges, descriptive only.
limitations: Not a biological composition adjustment, independent gene replication, causal attribution or FDR-controlled enrichment.
Different stage descriptors, reference-transfer failures and source-design uncertainty persist.
No selection of a favored reference or threshold from the inspected outcomes; all scenarios retained.
